To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we present MANA (MPI-agnostic network-agnostic transparent checkpointing) for MPI, 2) MANA supports all MPI implementations, 3) MANA supports any network interconnect, and 4) the performance penalty for checkpointing with MANA is insignificant.

(i) we have implemented a single code base that supports all MPI implementations, and all interconnect combinations, (ii) the runtime overhead of the transparent checkpointing service is negligible, (iii) the checkpointing service is MPI implementation agnostic, (iv) the checkpointing services is interconnect agnostic, and (v) the checkpointing system supports both local and remote checkpointing.
we have created a single code base that transparently supports all MPI implementations over all interconnects, and that this code base has negligible runtime overhead.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an MPI-agnostic, transparent checkpoint-restart service for MPI applications.

the design, development, implementation, and evaluation of a single, portable code base that provides transparent checkpointing for all MPI implementations, all network interconnect types, and all combinations thereof.
the problem of MPI fault tolerance and load management in HPC, and the solution is an agnostic MPI transparent checkpoint/restart service.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this approach is a viable alternative to the two most widely deployed checkpointing solutions, and that it is a viable solution for checkpointing MPI applications for fault tolerance and/or load balancing.
MANA is the first transparent checkpointing solution that works across MPI implementations, across network interconnects, and across clusters.

the proposed technique is a practical solution for transparently checkpointing MPI applications over all MPI implementations and network interconnects, and that the technique is both efficient and transparent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MANA provides a single, agnostic checkpoint-restart service that is MPI-agnostic and network-agnostic, and is transparently integrated into an MPI implementation.
MANA can transparently checkpoint any MPI application running on any MPI implementation over any network interconnect, with negligible performance impact.
MANA provides a unified checkpointing framework for all MPI implementations and network interconnects, and that it is transparent to the MPI application.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to build an agnostic transparent checkpointing system that is both efficient and easy to use.
it is possible to achieve MPI agnosticism and network agnosticism in transparent checkpointing.
transparent checkpoint-restart can be made MPI-agnostic, which will greatly simplify the task of deploying fault tolerance services in a cluster environment.
